//: Preload must be CommonJS: Electron loads it with require(), and require() of an ES module throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, silently killing the whole capability bridge and leaving the window painted but empty. Only preload.ts is compiled here — it imports nothing at runtime (the IPC channel names are inlined), so the output is a single self-contained file. scripts/finalize-preload.mjs renames it to .cjs and asserts that self-containment still holds.
